blocks.text: Present Perfect Continuous (→ 9-dars) va Present Perfect Simple (→ 7–8-darslar) ikkalasi ham o'tmishni hozirga bog'laydi. Farqi — **diqqat qayerda**. **have been + -ing** — diqqat **faoliyatning o'zida**: nima bilan band bo'ldim, qancha vaqt, izi qolganmi; ish tugaganmi-yo'qmi — muhim emas, ko'pincha hali tugamagan. **have + V3** — diqqat **natijada**: ish tugagan, tayyor, sanash mumkin. O'zbekchada farq taxminan shunday: «bo'**yayapman** / bo'yab yuribman» va «bo'yab **bo'ldim** / bo'yab **qo'ydim**».

rows: I**'ve been reading** your report. (o'qiyapman, hali tugatmadim)
She**'s been writing** emails all morning. (band bo'ldi)
She**'s written** ten emails this morning. (natija — son)
We**'ve been cleaning** the house. (charchadik, chang-to'zon)
It**'s rained** a lot this week. (umumiy miqdor)

items.text: My hands are dirty because I**'ve been gardening**.
I**'ve planted** forty tulips, so the garden will look lovely in spring.
items.translation: Qirqta lola **ekib qo'ydim**, bahorda bog' juda chiroyli bo'ladi.

blocks.text: How long? va How much / How many?

Savolning o'zi zamonni aytib beradi. **How long ...?** — davomiylik, jarayon → have been + -ing. **How much / How many / How many times / How far ...?** — miqdor, natija → have + V3. Gapda son yoki miqdor bo'lsa (three emails, ten kilometres, twice, half the book), Continuous ishlatilmaydi: «I've been writing three emails» ✗ → I**'ve written** three emails.

rows: How long ...? / for / since / all day
I**'ve drunk** three cups of tea.
I**'ve finished** the essay at last.

items.text: How long **have** you **been driving**? — Since six in the morning.
items.translation: Qancha vaqtdan beri **mashina haydayapsiz**? — Ertalab soat oltidan beri.

items.text: How far **have** you **driven** today? — About five hundred kilometres.
items.translation: Bugun qancha masofa **yurdingiz**? — Besh yuz kilometrcha.

blocks.text: have been doing ish tugaganini **aytmaydi**: I**'ve been reading** the book you lent me — hali o'qiyapman. have done esa ish **tugaganini** aytadi: I**'ve read** it — o'qib bo'ldim, qaytarib beraman. Shikoyat ohangidagi savollarda ham farq bor: **Who's been using** my laptop? — kimdir foydalangan, izlari bor (sozlamalar o'zgargan). **Who's broken** my laptop? — natija: noutbuk singan.

items.text: Who**'s been using** my laptop? The settings are all different.
items.translation: Noutbukimdan kim **foydalandi**? Sozlamalar butunlay o'zgarib ketibdi.

items.text: Who**'s broken** my laptop? The screen is cracked.

blocks.text: **Holat fe'llari** (know, have = ega, own, be, believe, like — → 4-dars) faqat have + V3: I**'ve had** this car for ten years. **Bir lahzalik harakatlar** (lose, find, break, arrive, start, die) ham bir martalik bo'lsa — faqat have + V3: I**'ve lost** my keys («I've been losing» ✗). Lekin ular **takrorlansa**, Continuous mumkin: I**'ve been calling** you all day (ko'p marta) — I**'ve called** you three times (son).

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I've been writing three letters.» → I**'ve written** three letters. (son bor — Simple); «How many pages have you been reading?» → How many pages **have** you **read**?; «I've been knowing her for years.» → I**'ve known** her for years.; «I've been losing my keys.» (bir marta) → I**'ve lost** my keys.; xona hali bo'yalmagan bo'lsa «I've painted the room.» → I**'ve been painting** the room.; «ta'mirlab bo'ldik» → we**'ve decorated**, «ta'mirlayapmiz, ancha vaqtdan beri» → we**'ve been decorating**.

Javob qaysi savolga berilyapti? «**Nima bilan band bo'ldingiz, qancha vaqt?**» → have been + -ing. «**Nima tayyor, qancha, nechta?**» → have + V3. O'zbekchada «**-ib bo'ldim**», «**-ib qo'ydim**» eshitsangiz — deyarli doim have + V3.

live, work, study, teach kabi fe'llar bilan ikkalasi ham mumkin, ma'no farqi kam (I**'ve lived** / I**'ve been living** here for years) → 11-dars. for va since → 12-dars. O'tmishdagi xuddi shunday juftlik — had been doing / had done → 15–16-darslar.

examples.title: Activity or result? **been painting** / **painted**
examples.description: have been doing — jarayon (hali tugamagan bo'lishi mumkin, izi ko'rinadi); have done — tugagan ish va uning natijasi. Juftliklar.

sentences.text: I**'ve been painting** the bedroom, so my clothes are covered in paint.
sentences.translation: Yotoqxonani **bo'yayapman**, shuning uchun kiyimlarim bo'yoqqa belanib ketgan.

sentences.text: I**'ve painted** the bedroom — come and see what you think of the colour.
sentences.translation: Yotoqxonani **bo'yab bo'ldim** — kelib, rangi qandayligini ko'r.

sentences.text: Aziz **has been repairing** the car all morning, but it still won't start.
sentences.translation: Aziz ertalabdan beri mashinani **tuzatyapti**, lekin u hali ham o't olmayapti.

sentences.text: Aziz **has repaired** the car, so we can drive to Samarkand tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Aziz mashinani **tuzatib bo'ldi**, ertaga Samarqandga bora olamiz.

sentences.text: Sorry, the floor is wet — we**'ve been cleaning** the kitchen.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, pol ho'l — oshxonani **tozalayotgan edik**.

sentences.text: We**'ve cleaned** the kitchen, so it's your turn to do the bathroom.
sentences.translation: Oshxonani **tozalab bo'ldik**, endi hammomni tozalash navbati senda.

sentences.text: Kate **has been writing** her novel for three years and hopes to finish it soon.
sentences.translation: Keyt uch yildan beri romanini **yozyapti** va uni tez orada tugatishga umid qiladi.

sentences.text: Kate **has written** three novels, and the latest one is a bestseller.
sentences.translation: Keyt uchta roman **yozgan**, oxirgisi eng ko'p sotilayotgan kitoblar qatorida.

sentences.text: The children **have been making** a snowman — look at their red cheeks!
sentences.translation: Bolalar qorbobo **yasashyapti** — qizarib ketgan yuzlariga qara!

sentences.text: The children **have made** a huge snowman in front of the house.
sentences.translation: Bolalar uy oldida ulkan qorbobo **yasab qo'yishdi**.

examples.title: How long? / How many? — process and quantity
examples.description: How long ...? (qancha vaqtdan beri) — have been + -ing; How much / How many ...? (qancha, nechta) — have + V3.

sentences.text: How long **have** you **been reading** this book? — About a week.
sentences.translation: Bu kitobni qancha vaqtdan beri **o'qiyapsiz**? — Bir haftacha.

sentences.text: How many pages **have** you **read** so far? — Nearly three hundred.
sentences.translation: Hozircha necha bet **o'qidingiz**? — Uch yuzga yaqin.

sentences.text: Tom **has been jogging** for forty minutes, and he isn't tired yet.
sentences.translation: Tom qirq daqiqadan beri **yuguryapti**, hali charchagani yo'q.

sentences.text: Tom **has run** eight kilometres, which is his personal best.
sentences.translation: Tom sakkiz kilometr **yugurdi**, bu uning shaxsiy rekordi.

sentences.text: How much money **have** you **saved** for the trip to London?
sentences.translation: London safari uchun qancha pul **yig'dingiz**?

sentences.text: Nilufar **has been saving** for a car since she started her job.
sentences.translation: Nilufar ishga kirganidan beri mashina uchun pul **yig'yapti**.

sentences.text: We**'ve been walking** all day — my feet are killing me!
sentences.translation: Kun bo'yi **piyoda yurdik** — oyoqlarim zirqirab og'riyapti!

sentences.text: We**'ve walked** about twenty kilometres, according to my phone.
sentences.translation: Telefonimga ko'ra, taxminan yigirma kilometr **piyoda yurdik**.

sentences.text: So, how many cups of tea **has** Grandad **drunk** this afternoon?
sentences.translation: Xo'sh, bobom tushdan keyin necha piyola choy **ichdi**?

sentences.text: Bekzod **has been drinking** too much coffee lately, and now he can't sleep.
sentences.translation: Bekzod so'nggi paytlarda juda ko'p qahva **ichyapti**, endi esa uxlay olmayapti.

examples.title: Numbers and amounts: **have written** three emails
examples.description: Son, miqdor, necha marta aytilsa — faqat have + V3: I've written three emails («I've been writing three emails» ✗). Jarayon va davomiylik — have been + -ing.

sentences.text: I**'ve been writing** emails all morning, and I**'ve sent** twenty-three of them.
sentences.translation: Ertalabdan beri xat **yozyapman**, ulardan yigirma uchtasini **yubordim**.

sentences.text: Madina **has visited** her grandmother twice this week.
sentences.translation: Madina bu hafta buvisinikiga ikki marta **borib keldi**.

sentences.text: The kids **have eaten** all the biscuits — there aren't any left.
sentences.translation: Bolalar hamma pechenyeni **yeb qo'yishibdi** — birortasi ham qolmabdi.

sentences.text: James **has been interviewing** candidates since nine, and he**'s seen** six so far.
sentences.translation: Jeyms soat to'qqizdan beri nomzodlar bilan **suhbat o'tkazyapti**, hozircha oltitasini **ko'rdi**.

sentences.text: Our team **has scored** fifteen goals in the last three matches.
sentences.translation: Jamoamiz so'nggi uch o'yinda o'n beshta gol **urdi**.

sentences.text: How many times **have** you **checked** your phone in the last hour?
sentences.translation: So'nggi bir soatda telefoningni necha marta **tekshirding**?

sentences.text: Dilnoza **has translated** half the contract, but there are still twenty pages to go.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza shartnomaning yarmini **tarjima qildi**, lekin hali yigirma bet qoldi.

sentences.text: We**'ve been picking** apples since dawn, and we**'ve filled** thirty boxes.
sentences.translation: Tongdan beri olma **teryapmiz**, o'ttizta qutini **to'ldirdik**.

sentences.text: The factory **has produced** a million bottles this year.
sentences.translation: Zavod bu yil bir million shisha **ishlab chiqardi**.

sentences.text: Oliver **has lost** three kilos since he started cycling to work.
sentences.translation: Oliver ishga velosipedda qatnay boshlaganidan beri uch kilo **ozdi**.

examples.title: Finished or not? **been reading** / **read**
examples.description: have been doing ish tugaganini aytmaydi (ko'pincha hali tugamagan); have done — ish tugagan. O'zbekchada «o'qiyapman» va «o'qib chiqdim».

sentences.text: I**'ve been reading** the book you lent me, but I haven't finished it yet.
sentences.translation: Sen bergan kitobni **o'qiyapman**, lekin hali tugatganim yo'q.

sentences.text: Emma **has read** the whole report and found three mistakes.
sentences.translation: Emma hisobotni to'liq **o'qib chiqdi** va uchta xato topdi.

sentences.text: Jasur **has been building** a website for his uncle's shop, and it's nearly ready.
sentences.translation: Jasur amakisining do'koni uchun veb-sayt **yasayapti**, u deyarli tayyor.

sentences.text: The builders **have finished** the new school, and it opens in September.
sentences.translation: Quruvchilar yangi maktabni **qurib bitkazishdi**, u sentyabrda ochiladi.

sentences.text: **Have** you **been doing** your homework, or **have** you **been playing** games?
sentences.translation: Uy vazifasini **qildingmi** yoki o'yin **o'ynab o'tirdingmi**?

sentences.text: **Have** you **done** your homework? Show me, please.
sentences.translation: Uy vazifangni **qilib bo'ldingmi**? Ko'rsat-chi.

sentences.text: Sarah **has been learning** the new software, but she still asks me for help.
sentences.translation: Sara yangi dasturni **o'rganyapti**, lekin hali ham mendan yordam so'raydi.

sentences.text: Sarah **has learnt** all the shortcuts, so she works twice as fast now.
sentences.translation: Sara barcha tezkor tugmalarni **o'rganib oldi**, endi ikki baravar tez ishlaydi.

sentences.text: The government **has been discussing** the new law for months, but nothing has changed.
sentences.translation: Hukumat bir necha oydan beri yangi qonunni **muhokama qilyapti**, lekin hech narsa o'zgarmadi.

sentences.text: Parliament **has passed** the new law, so it will come into force next year.
sentences.translation: Parlament yangi qonunni **qabul qildi**, u kelasi yildan kuchga kiradi.

examples.title: Repeated or counted: **been calling** / **called**
examples.description: Takror-takror qilinayotgan harakat — have been + -ing (I've been calling you all day); necha marta yoki bir martalik natija — have + V3 (She has called three times).

sentences.text: I**'ve been calling** you all day — why didn't you answer?
sentences.translation: Kun bo'yi senga **qo'ng'iroq qilyapman** — nega ko'tarmading?

sentences.text: Your mum **has called** three times — she wants you to ring her back.
sentences.translation: Onang uch marta **qo'ng'iroq qildi** — qayta qo'ng'iroq qilishingni so'radi.

sentences.text: Bekzod **has been applying** for jobs for months, but nobody has replied.
sentences.translation: Bekzod bir necha oydan beri ishga **ariza topshiryapti**, lekin hech kim javob bermadi.

sentences.text: Bekzod **has applied** for a job at the British embassy.
sentences.translation: Bekzod Britaniya elchixonasidagi ishga **ariza topshirdi**.

sentences.text: The neighbours **have been arguing** again — I can hear them through the wall.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilar yana **janjallashyapti** — devor orqali eshitib turibman.

sentences.text: Someone **has been taking** money from the till, and the manager wants to find out who.
sentences.translation: Kimdir kassadan pul **o'g'irlab kelyapti**, menejer esa kimligini aniqlamoqchi.

sentences.text: Someone **has taken** my sandwich from the office fridge!
sentences.translation: Kimdir ofis muzlatkichidan sendvichimni **olib ketibdi**!

sentences.text: Emma **has been visiting** her father in hospital every evening.
sentences.translation: Emma har kuni kechqurun kasalxonadagi otasini **yo'qlab turibdi**.

sentences.text: Tom **has knocked** on the door twice, but nobody is answering.
sentences.translation: Tom eshikni ikki marta **taqillatdi**, lekin hech kim ochmayapti.

sentences.text: My little brother **has been asking** me the same question for an hour!
sentences.translation: Ukam bir soatdan beri menga bir xil savolni **berib turibdi**!

examples.title: State and one-off verbs: **have known**, **have lost**
examples.description: Holat fe'llari (know, have, own, be, trust) va bir martalik lahzalik harakatlar (lose, find, break, arrive, land) — odatda faqat have + V3.

sentences.text: Aziz and I **have known** each other since we were at university in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Aziz ikkovimiz Samarqandda universitetda o'qiganimizdan beri bir-birimizni **taniymiz**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **has had** the same phone for six years and refuses to change it.
sentences.translation: Dilnozada olti yildan beri bir xil telefon **bor**, uni almashtirishni xohlamaydi.

sentences.text: My grandfather **has owned** this shop since 1985.
sentences.translation: Bobom bu do'konga 1985-yildan beri **egalik qiladi**.

sentences.text: Oh no, I**'ve broken** my glasses, and I can't see the screen.
sentences.translation: Voy, ko'zoynagimni **sindirib oldim**, ekranni ko'ra olmayapman.

sentences.text: The guests **have arrived** — can you open the door?
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar **kelishdi** — eshikni ochib yubora olasanmi?

sentences.text: Kate **has been** a vegetarian for ten years.
sentences.translation: Keyt o'n yildan beri **vegetarian**.

sentences.text: **Have** you **found** your keys? — Yes, they were in my coat.
sentences.translation: Kalitlaringni **topdingmi**? — Ha, paltomda ekan.

sentences.text: Aziz **has always believed** that hard work pays off.
sentences.translation: Aziz mehnat albatta o'z mevasini beradi, deb doim **ishonib kelgan**.

sentences.text: Our flight **has landed**, but we're still waiting for our luggage.
sentences.translation: Samolyotimiz **qo'ndi**, lekin hali yuklarimizni kutyapmiz.

sentences.text: Nobody **has trusted** the old manager since the scandal last year.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yilgi janjaldan beri eski menejerga hech kim **ishonmaydi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: decorating a new flat
examples.description: Kvartira ta'miri haqida suhbat: nima qilinyapti (jarayon) va nima tayyor (natija) — have been doing va have done yonma-yon.

sentences.text: — Hi, Madina! What **have** you **been doing**? You've got paint in your hair!
sentences.translation: — Salom, Madina! Nima **qilayotgan eding**? Sochingda bo'yoq bor-ku!

sentences.text: — We**'ve been decorating** the new flat all weekend.
sentences.translation: — Dam olish kunlari bo'yi yangi kvartirani **ta'mirlash bilan band bo'ldik**.

sentences.text: — How much **have** you **done** so far?
sentences.translation: — Hozircha qanchasini **qilib bo'ldingizlar**?

sentences.text: — We**'ve painted** two rooms, and Jasur **has fixed** all the lights.
sentences.translation: — Ikkita xonani **bo'yadik**, Jasur esa hamma chiroqlarni **tuzatib qo'ydi**.

sentences.text: — Impressive! And **has** he **been working** on the bathroom too?
sentences.translation: — Ajoyib! Hammom ustida ham **ishlayaptimi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, he**'s been laying** new tiles since Friday, but he hasn't finished yet.
sentences.translation: — Ha, jumadan beri yangi kafel **yotqizyapti**, lekin hali tugatgani yo'q.

sentences.text: — How long **have** you **been living** there without a bathroom?
sentences.translation: — Hammomsiz u yerda qancha vaqtdan beri **yashayapsizlar**?

sentences.text: — Only a week. We**'ve been using** my parents' shower.
sentences.translation: — Bor-yo'g'i bir hafta. Ota-onamnikidagi dushdan **foydalanib turibmiz**.

sentences.text: — Well, you**'ve done** a lot in a short time — I'd love to see it.
sentences.translation: — Qisqa vaqtda ko'p ish **qilibsizlar** — ko'rgim kelyapti.

sentences.text: — Come on Saturday — we**'ve** already **bought** a new sofa for guests!
sentences.translation: — Shanba kuni kel — mehmonlar uchun yangi divan ham **sotib olib qo'yganmiz**!

examples.title: Mixed: work, health and home
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: jarayon (have been doing) va natija, miqdor (have done) — kundalik va ish vaziyatlarida, ko'pincha bitta gapda.

sentences.text: The doctor says my blood pressure **has gone down** because I**'ve been walking** every day.
sentences.translation: Shifokorning aytishicha, har kuni **piyoda yurayotganim** uchun qon bosimim **tushibdi**.

sentences.text: Our company **has been expanding** fast, and this year it **has opened** offices in three new cities.
sentences.translation: Kompaniyamiz tez **kengaymoqda**, bu yil uchta yangi shaharda ofis **ochdi**.

sentences.text: Jasur **has been revising** for weeks, and now he**'s passed** his final exam with top marks.
sentences.translation: Jasur bir necha hafta **takrorlab yurgan edi**, endi esa yakuniy imtihonni a'lo baholarga **topshirdi**.

sentences.text: Why are you so tired? **Have** you **been working** late again?
sentences.translation: Nega bunchalik charchagansan? Yana kechgacha **ishladingmi**?

sentences.text: Scientists **have been studying** the Aral Sea for decades, and they **have published** hundreds of reports.
sentences.translation: Olimlar o'n yillardan beri Orol dengizini **o'rganib kelmoqda**, yuzlab hisobotlar **chop etishgan**.

sentences.text: Mum **has cooked** enough plov for thirty people — who's coming?
sentences.translation: Oyim o'ttiz kishiga yetadigan palov **damlabdi** — kim keladi?

sentences.text: Since the new manager arrived, the team **has been working** much more efficiently.
sentences.translation: Yangi menejer kelganidan beri jamoa ancha samarali **ishlayapti**.

sentences.text: Kate **has been trying** to give up sugar, and so far she**'s managed** two weeks.
sentences.translation: Keyt shakarni tashlashga **harakat qilyapti**, hozircha ikki haftaga **chidadi**.

sentences.text: Prices **have risen** three times this year, and people **have been complaining** about it online.
sentences.translation: Bu yil narxlar uch marta **oshdi**, odamlar internetda bundan **shikoyat qilishyapti**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **has been looking** for his passport for an hour, but he **hasn't found** it yet.
sentences.translation: Bekzod bir soatdan beri pasportini **qidiryapti**, lekin hali **topgani yo'q**.
